room_session_participants_nonneg.name: room_session_participants_nonneg
room_session_participants_nonneg.value: "room_session_participants"."solved_count" BETWEEN 0 AND 8 AND "room_session_participants"."penalty_sec" >= 0 AND ("room_session_participants"."rank" IS NULL OR "room_session_participants"."rank" >= 1)

room_session_problems_kind.name: room_session_problems_kind
room_session_problems_kind.value:
("room_session_problems"."problem_id" IS NOT NULL AND "room_session_problems"."difficulty" IS NOT NULL AND "room_session_problems"."external_slug" IS NULL
          AND "room_session_problems"."external_title" IS NULL AND "room_session_problems"."external_rating" IS NULL AND "room_session_problems"."external_problem_id" IS NULL)
        OR ("room_session_problems"."problem_id" IS NULL AND "room_session_problems"."external_slug" IS NOT NULL AND "room_session_problems"."external_title" IS NOT NULL
          AND char_length("room_session_problems"."external_slug") BETWEEN 1 AND 100 AND "room_session_problems"."external_slug" ~ '^[a-z0-9]+(-[a-z0-9]+)*$'
          AND char_length("room_session_problems"."external_title") BETWEEN 1 AND 100 AND "room_session_problems"."external_title" !~ '[[:cntrl:]]'
          AND ("room_session_problems"."external_rating" IS NULL OR "room_session_problems"."external_rating" BETWEEN 0 AND 4000)
          AND "room_session_problems"."rating_at_start" IS NULL AND "room_session_problems"."rating_delta" IS NULL AND NOT "room_session_problems"."pinned")

room_session_results_counts.name: room_session_results_counts
room_session_results_counts.value:
"room_session_results"."attempts" >= 0 AND "room_session_results"."wrong_before_accept" BETWEEN 0 AND "room_session_results"."attempts"
        AND ("room_session_results"."solve_seconds" IS NULL OR "room_session_results"."solve_seconds" >= 0)
        AND ("room_session_results"."first_accepted_at" IS NULL OR "room_session_results"."attempts" > "room_session_results"."wrong_before_accept")

room_sessions_state.name: room_sessions_state
room_sessions_state.value:
("room_sessions"."status" = 'lobby' AND "room_sessions"."started_at" IS NULL AND "room_sessions"."ends_at" IS NULL AND "room_sessions"."ended_at" IS NULL AND "room_sessions"."end_reason" IS NULL)
        OR ("room_sessions"."status" = 'live' AND "room_sessions"."started_at" IS NOT NULL AND "room_sessions"."ends_at" IS NOT NULL AND "room_sessions"."ended_at" IS NULL AND "room_sessions"."end_reason" IS NULL)
        OR ("room_sessions"."status" = 'finished' AND "room_sessions"."started_at" IS NOT NULL AND "room_sessions"."ends_at" IS NOT NULL AND "room_sessions"."ended_at" IS NOT NULL AND "room_sessions"."end_reason" IS NOT NULL AND "room_sessions"."end_reason" IN ('time', 'host'))
        OR ("room_sessions"."status" = 'cancelled' AND "room_sessions"."started_at" IS NULL AND "room_sessions"."ends_at" IS NULL AND "room_sessions"."ended_at" IS NOT NULL AND "room_sessions"."end_reason" IS NOT NULL AND "room_sessions"."end_reason" IN ('cancelled', 'stale'))

submissions_metrics_nonnegative.name: submissions_metrics_nonnegative
submissions_metrics_nonnegative.value: ("submissions"."runtime_ms" IS NULL OR "submissions"."runtime_ms" >= 0) AND ("submissions"."memory_kb" IS NULL OR "submissions"."memory_kb" >= 0)
